titulo: From LLM to a robot that acts
lead: A chatbot returns text. A robot has to return motion, dozens of times per second, while looking at a camera. This lesson separates the four model families you'll hear about in the course and shows what changed between 2023 and October 2026.
objetivo: tell LLM, VLM, VLA, and World Action Model apart and say what changed from 2023 to Oct 2026.

aprende.t: What goes in and what comes out of each model family
Why a VLA returns an action, not text
What a World Action Model is, the new category of 2026
Classify real systems with the source next to you

hero_alt: Robotics lab with a two-arm station and a humanoid in the background.

secoes.titulo: The ladder: from text to motion
secoes.sub: Each step adds an input or an output. Tap each one.

nos.detalhe: Large language model. It reads text and writes text. It knows a lot about the world, but it sees nothing and moves nothing.

itens.t: In: a photo and a question

nos.detalhe: Vision-language model. It looks at an image and answers questions about it. It is the base of most VLAs: NVIDIA's GR00T N1.7, for example, uses the Cosmos-Reason2-2B VLM as the part that understands the scene (Apr/2026).

itens.t: In: camera, a sentence, and the robot's state

nos.detalhe: Vision, language, and action. It takes the camera feed, the instruction ("pick up the cup"), and the robot's state, and returns the next actions. Examples: OpenVLA (7B, Jun/2024), π0 and π0.5 from Physical Intelligence (2024–2025), SmolVLA from Hugging Face (450M, Jun/2025).

nos.sub: predicts the future video and the action

itens.t: and the actions that lead to them

nos.detalhe: World Action Model. Instead of only predicting the action, the model also predicts the video of what will happen. NVIDIA's DreamZero (14B, Feb/2026) is the reference example; GR00T N2, announced in Mar/2026, uses this architecture and had no confirmed release as of Oct/2026.

secoes.legenda: LLMs and VLMs answer. VLAs and WAMs act: the output becomes a motor command.
secoes.dica: The question that settles it: what comes out of the model? Text, action, or video + action.

texto: Open X-Embodiment (2023) merged dozens of datasets from different labs into a single format. It was the basis for training one model across many robots.
In Jun/2024, the 7B OpenVLA was pretrained on 970 thousand episodes from that collection, with open weights.

exemplo.texto: One model, trained on data from many robots, instead of one model per robot.

texto: π0 introduced an "action expert" using flow matching: instead of picking the action from a list of values, it generates the action as a continuous value. The code and weights are in the openpi repository, under the Apache-2.0 license.

Action chunking came along with it and remains a foundation (the OpenVLA-OFT recipe, from Feb/2025, uses it): the model returns a chunk of several actions at once. You will understand both in lesson 2.
Figure's Helix 02 (Jan/2026) controls the entire humanoid and gained a third layer, S0, running at 1 kHz.
Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2 (07/30/2026) controls humanoids "from toes to fingertips" and, according to Google, adapts to a new body usually with fewer than 200 examples.

The World Action Model category emerges: DreamZero (Feb/2026) predicts video and action together. NVIDIA's Cosmos 3 (weights on the Hub on 05/31/2026) can serve as a VLM, a simulator, or a base for this kind of model.
At the same time, PI's frontier models went closed: π0.7 (Apr/2026) has no weights, and on 10/13/2026 PI opened a commercial API in beta.

exemplo.texto: Open and closed coexist. In lesson 3 you choose based on what you can actually use.

abas.html:
• OpenVLA: camera + sentence → action. VLA. openvla.github.io
  • π0.5: camera + sentence + state → action. VLA. github.com/Physical-Intelligence/openpi
  • Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6: images + question → spatial reasoning, points, instrument reading. Embodied reasoning model (VLM family): it does not move the robot on its own. deepmind.google/blog/gemini-robotics-er-1-6/
  • DreamZero: camera + sentence → future video + action. WAM. arxiv.org/abs/2602.15922
  • Cosmos 3: world foundation model that combines world generation, reasoning, and action prediction; it serves as a base for WAM. huggingface.co/nvidia/Cosmos3-Super
  • SmolVLA: camera + sentence + state → action. Small VLA (450M). huggingface.co/blog/smolvla

• Calling every robot model a VLA: ER 1.6 reasons and points, but a different policy moves the arm.
  • Secondhand sources: news helps you find things, but the sheet asks for the official blog, the paper, or the model card.

secoes.sub: Use primary sources only: official blog, paper, or model card.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: What separates a VLA from a VLM?
opcoes: The VLA returns actions for the robot; the VLM returns text.
The VLM does not accept images.
The VLA does not use language.
perguntas.explica: Both see and read. The difference is the output: the VLA returns action (joints, gripper). Size does not define the category: SmolVLA is 450M.

perguntas.p: What does a World Action Model do beyond a VLA?
opcoes: It also predicts video of what will happen.
perguntas.explica: The WAM predicts future video and action together, like DreamZero (Feb/2026). The thesis is that predicting the future teaches physics better than predicting the action alone.

perguntas.p: Which statement about Physical Intelligence models is correct in Oct/2026?
opcoes: All of them have open weights.
None of them has open weights.
π0 and π0.5 have open weights in openpi; π0.7 is closed.
perguntas.explica: openpi (Apache-2.0) ships π0, π0-FAST, and π0.5. Since π*0.6, new models are closed, and on 10/13/2026 PI opened a commercial API in beta.

perguntas.p: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 reads a pressure gauge and points to where to grasp. Which family does it belong to?
opcoes: VLA, because it is from robotics.
Embodied reasoning model (VLM family): it understands and points, but does not move the robot on its own.
WAM, because it predicts the future.
perguntas.explica: It takes in images and returns reasoning, points, and code. Something else, a separate policy, turns that into movement. Always look at what comes out of the model.

itens.texto: Text is an LLM or VLM. Action is a VLA. Future video + action is a WAM.
Helix 02 and Gemini Robotics 2 control entire humanoids, not just the arm.
π0/π0.5 are open; π0.7, Helix, and Gemini Robotics 2 are closed or partner-only.
